name: Sunny Day Real Estate
label: Sub Pop
lede: Four Seattle kids made one record so raw it named a genre, broke up before it was even two years old, and have spent thirty years coming back to finish the argument.

eras.title: Four names before the right one
eras.text: Two University of Washington housemates and a drummer started out playing instrumentals in grunge-era Seattle. The band went through three names and one singer before Jeremy Enigk walked in, and Sub Pop signed them almost as fast.

years.h: Dan Hoerner and Nate Mendel start a band in their shared house
years.p: University of Washington housemates Dan Hoerner and [[Nate Mendel|ba510f8c-f19d-41a2-921a-53afd27cfcbd]] recruit drummer [[William Goldsmith|585256d1-d013-409e-824d-0e4d847d8016]]. They play as Empty Set, then Chewbacca Kaboom, then One Day I Stopped Breathing.
years.xp:
Sunny Day Real Estate came last. Nate Mendel says the name was a random thought that came from the Talking Heads song (Nothing But) Flowers.

The trio started out instrumental, then Hoerner took the mic. They self-released a 7-inch, Flatland Spider.

years.h: Jeremy Enigk joins, poached from a side project
years.p: While Nate Mendel tours with [[Christ on a Crutch|5c8c891c-04b5-49d1-94c2-2ed242a93df0]], William Goldsmith starts a side band, Thief, Steal Me a Peach, with high school friend [[Jeremy Enigk|35058042-8310-4c5c-852c-f0ed011d77b0]]. Dan Hoerner talks Mendel into letting Enigk join Sunny Day Real Estate.
years.xp: The side project's name survived as the title of a 1993 7-inch. Its two songs, 8 and 9, later came back as bonus tracks on the 2009 reissue of Diary.

years.h: Sub Pop's Jonathan Poneman signs Sunny Day Real Estate
years.p: Sub Pop co-founder Jonathan Poneman sees the band play in Seattle and signs them. Sub Pop's own bio says it was only their second show.

years.h: Recording Diary at Idful in Chicago with Brad Wood
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate cut their debut at Idful studio in Chicago with producer and engineer [[Brad Wood|58c8c056-4f9a-4a3b-8dd9-69b06bb23c28]], with M. Casey Rice assisting.
years.xp: The guitars owe debts the band has named: [[Fugazi|233fc3f3-6de2-465c-985e-e721dbabbace]]-style octave parts in 48 and Grendel, and Dan Hoerner's delay borrowed from U2's The Edge. Grendel takes its story from John Gardner's 1971 novel.

eras.title: One interview, one photo, one pink record
eras.text: Diary made Sunny Day Real Estate the most talked-about band on Sub Pop, and the band talked back almost not at all. Inside two years they had a classic debut, a refusal to play California, and a breakup announced before the second album was even out.

years.h: Diary comes out on Sub Pop
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate's debut. The cover's little figures look like Fisher-Price Little People, and the butterfly was drawn by Nate Mendel's father, John Mendel.
years.xp:
Jeremy Enigk has said the whole record was inspired by a high school girlfriend who broke his heart. In Circles started life as his solo acoustic song before the band rebuilt it.

Diary never charted, yet by 2008 it had sold more than 231,000 copies, making it the seventh best-selling record in Sub Pop's history. Rolling Stone ranked it No. 1 of the 40 greatest emo albums in 2016.

years.h: Sunny Day Real Estate give one interview and one photo
years.p: While promoting Diary the band grants a single interview and releases a single publicity photo. They also refuse to play California, and never say why.

years.h: "Seven" on The Jon Stewart Show, then MTV's 120 Minutes
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate play their lead single Seven on The Jon Stewart Show, and soon after tape songs for MTV's 120 Minutes.

years.h: Dave Grohl leaves William Goldsmith a note at a show
years.p: [[Dave Grohl|4d5f891d-9bce-45ae-ad86-912dd27252fa]], putting together [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]] after [[Kurt Cobain|3c9b356d-d1db-4f4e-a7a3-2d00c1d70255]]'s death, leaves a note for drummer William Goldsmith at a Sunny Day Real Estate gig. Goldsmith joins that month.

years.h: On tour with Shudder to Think and Soul Coughing
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate's U.S. tour with [[Shudder to Think|5a6e19e0-3ff0-4b3d-869e-3c539d6d8707]] and Soul Coughing closes out 1994. William Goldsmith later said the split was planned before this tour began.

years.h: Dan Hoerner refuses to play KROQ's Almost Acoustic Christmas
years.p: Asked to play KROQ's Almost Acoustic Christmas in Los Angeles, Dan Hoerner says no. Jeremy Enigk, Nate Mendel and William Goldsmith play it as a trio.

years.big: Split before the second album was out
q: I was young and I had just experienced a major spiritual explosion
years.src: Wikipedia · Sub Pop · This Was The Scene
years.h: Sunny Day Real Estate break up, and Jeremy Enigk finds God
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate announce they're done. The talk centers on Jeremy Enigk's conversion to Christianity, though the band later played that down.
years.xp:
Enigk answered the rumors in a letter to a fan, writing that he had called on God and that his pain was gone. In June 2020, William Goldsmith told the This Was The Scene podcast the split was mostly about the band's lack of success and Enigk's wish to leave, and that it had been planned before their first U.S. tour.

Sub Pop's bio puts the end in spring 1995 and blames internal tensions.

years.h: Nate Mendel and William Goldsmith become Foo Fighters
years.p: With Sunny Day Real Estate gone, Nate Mendel and William Goldsmith are the rhythm section in Dave Grohl's [[Foo Fighters|67f66c07-6e61-4026-ade5-7e782fad3a5d]], touring in 1995 in support of [[Mike Watt|568203ae-c27b-4990-8997-09c0d5c0de77]].

years.h: LP2, the Pink Album, comes out after the breakup
years.p: Sub Pop releases the second Sunny Day Real Estate album with no artwork and no liner notes. William Goldsmith suggested a plain pink cover when the band had nothing else to give.
years.xp: Jeremy Enigk said in 2008 that the band had put no energy into anything once they'd split. Several songs have no real lyrics at all: Enigk sang sounds, not words.

eras.title: A frog queen and a drummer's 96 takes
eras.text: The four went four ways: a solo record, a farm, and the biggest new rock band in America. Then the Foo Fighters job went sour for William Goldsmith, and Sub Pop came asking for a rarities album.

years.h: Jeremy Enigk goes solo with Return of the Frog Queen
years.p: Jeremy Enigk's first solo album arrives while Dan Hoerner retreats to a farm in rural Washington.

years.h: Dave Grohl re-records William Goldsmith's drums in secret
years.p: During sessions for Foo Fighters' The Colour and the Shape, Dave Grohl replaces William Goldsmith's drum tracks without telling him. Goldsmith hears it from Nate Mendel and quits.
years.xp: Goldsmith says Grohl had him do 96 takes of one song and thirteen hours of takes on another. Grohl offered to keep him on as the touring drummer; Goldsmith felt betrayed and left, and Taylor Hawkins took the job. Mendel stayed.

years.h: A Sub Pop rarities album turns into a reunion
years.p: Sub Pop pushes Jeremy Enigk and Dan Hoerner for a rarities comp. They decide to cut new songs instead and find the old fights have faded.
years.xp: The rarities would have included early 7-inches and a song the band made for The Crow: City of Angels soundtrack that went unused. Nate Mendel planned to leave Foo Fighters to rejoin, hesitated for months, then turned it down just before recording.

eras.title: Round two, without Mendel
eras.text: The reunited trio made two ambitious records, fell out with Sub Pop over a live album, and signed to a BMG-distributed label with big hopes. It ended in 2001 with the band's second breakup and a new name.

years.h: How It Feels to Be Something On, with Jeff Palmer on bass
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate's comeback, with former Mommyheads bassist Jeff Palmer in Nate Mendel's spot. The title track and Every Shining Time You Arrive were written for Jeremy Enigk's second solo album.
years.xp: Dan Hoerner's song 100 Million carries his environmental politics. Jeff Palmer didn't last long: Joe Skyward replaced him on bass.
play: How It Feels to Be Something On

years.h: Sunny Day Real Estate's Live sours them on Sub Pop
years.p: Sub Pop releases a live audio album and a live video. The band complains Sub Pop denied them approval of the artwork and mixes, and with their contract fulfilled, they leave the label.

years.h: The Rising Tide, on Time Bomb with Lou Giordano
years.p: Signed to Time Bomb Recordings, distributed by BMG, Sunny Day Real Estate work with [[Hüsker Dü|5c4c90a4-539f-4101-83cf-301bc6a94e06]] engineer Lou Giordano and head out on a long U.S. tour with high hopes. Greg Suran joins on guitar.

years.h: Second breakup: Sunny Day Real Estate become The Fire Theft
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate split again. Jeremy Enigk, William Goldsmith and Nate Mendel start over as [[The Fire Theft|cb8b0935-af9d-4d26-8ceb-dbfeeaf75aad]] rather than keep the old name.
years.xp: Mendel stayed in Foo Fighters and played with The Fire Theft when his schedule allowed. Their self-titled album came out in 2003. Enigk's solo album World Waits followed on October 17, 2006, on his own Lewis Hollow Records.

eras.title: All four, then the sock drawer
eras.text: The original four got back together for the first time since 1995, played Europe for the first time, and started a fifth album. The album never came out, and a decade later the drummer said who he blamed.

years.h: The original four Sunny Day Real Estate reunite
years.p: After reports in April, Seattle DJ Andrew Harms of 107.7 The End confirms it: Jeremy Enigk, Dan Hoerner, Nate Mendel and William Goldsmith are back together.

years.h: Surprise first reunion show at Hell's Kitchen, Tacoma
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate's first show in the original lineup since 1995 is a secret gig in Tacoma, Washington, kicking off a U.S. and Canada tour.
years.xp: On the tour they often played a new song, 10. On September 29 they played Seven on Late Night with Jimmy Fallon.

years.h: Sub Pop reissues Diary and LP2, remastered
years.p: Both Sub Pop albums come back remastered with bonus tracks and new liner notes. Diary adds 8 and 9 from the Thief, Steal Me a Peach 7-inch.

years.h: Soundwave, Coachella, then Sunny Day Real Estate's first Europe dates
years.p: Australia's Soundwave in February, then Coachella. Volcanic ash cancels their Groezrock set in Belgium; they make their European debut at Primavera Sound in Barcelona on May 29 and first UK show at London's HMV Forum on May 31.

years.h: The fifth Sunny Day Real Estate album falls apart
years.p: Dan Hoerner told Australia's FasterLouder a new album would start recording in May 2010. Nate Mendel said in 2013 that the sessions just fell apart.

years.h: "Lipton Witch" on a split 7-inch with Circa Survive
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate's first new music in 14 years comes out for Record Store Day, sharing a 7-inch with [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]].

years.h: William Goldsmith: the lost album is in Dave Grohl's sock drawer
years.p: On Facebook, William Goldsmith says the unfinished fifth Sunny Day Real Estate album was abandoned at Grohl's Studio 606. Nate Mendel, through Foo Fighters' representatives, denies it.
years.xp:
Goldsmith said Jeremy Enigk never got the moral support or engineering he deserved at Studio 606, and claimed Grohl disapproved of Mendel's time in The Fire Theft and so opposed finishing the record.

Goldsmith replied to Mendel's denial that the two hadn't spoken since 2011, when a planned conference call about finishing the album never happened.

eras.title: Back from Spokane, without Mendel
eras.text: The third reunion put three originals back on stage with a new bassist, starting in a club Dan Hoerner co-owns. It brought a 30th-birthday tour for Diary and the first new song in a decade.

years.h: Third reunion: Chris Jordan in for Nate Mendel
years.p: Spin confirms Jeremy Enigk, Dan Hoerner and William Goldsmith are back, with Chris Jordan on bass. A North American tour with [[The Appleseed Cast|61386f55-12b6-45be-baf2-7c9406965808]] is announced in May.

years.h: First show back at The Big Dipper, Dan Hoerner's Spokane club
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate restart at The Big Dipper in Spokane, Washington, a venue Dan Hoerner co-owns.

years.h: "Novum Vetus", a song from 1998, finally comes out
years.p: Teased with a tugboat drawing on Instagram, Novum Vetus dates from the How It Feels to Be Something On sessions. Greg Suran is back on guitar.

years.h: Diary turns 30: a tour and a pearlescent reissue
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate tour for Diary's 30th anniversary and Sub Pop puts the remastered, expanded edition back in print. They headline the first Best Friends Forever festival in Las Vegas.
years.xp: They also played Deftones' Dia de los Deftones in San Diego that year.

years.h: A 2025 tour covering songs from every Sunny Day Real Estate record
years.p: Sunny Day Real Estate play North America from May 28 to June 14 and September 3 to 24, including cities they hadn't played in years.
